result.topic_en: Ramanujan states two formulas expressing the sums of [x/n] sin 2nπθ and [x/n] cos 2nπθ (0<θ<1) as elementary terms plus infinite series of Bessel functions J_1 and of a function I_1 = H_1 − Y_1; a pencil note says they are allied to the divisor problem and new to the annotator.
result.transcription:
$0 < \theta < 1.$

$\left[\frac{x}{1}\right] \sin 2\pi\theta + \left[\frac{x}{2}\right] \sin 4\pi\theta + \left[\frac{x}{3}\right] \sin 6\pi\theta + \left[\frac{x}{4}\right] \sin 8\pi\theta + \cdots$

$= \pi x \left(\frac{1}{2} - \theta\right) - \frac{1}{4}\cot \pi\theta + \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{x} \sum_{\lambda=1}^{\lambda=\infty} \left\{ \frac{J_1(4\pi\sqrt{\lambda\theta x})}{\sqrt{\lambda\theta}} - \frac{J_1(4\pi\sqrt{\lambda(1-\theta)x})}{\sqrt{\lambda(1-\theta)}} + \frac{J_1(4\pi\sqrt{\lambda(1+\theta)x})}{\sqrt{\lambda(1+\theta)}} - \frac{J_1(4\pi\sqrt{\lambda(2-\theta)x})}{\sqrt{\lambda(2-\theta)}} + \frac{J_1(4\pi\sqrt{\lambda(2+\theta)x})}{\sqrt{\lambda(2+\theta)}} - \cdots\cdots \right\}$

where $[x]$ denotes the greatest integer in $x$ if $x$ is not an integer and $x - \frac{1}{2}$ if $x$ is an integer.

$\left[\frac{x}{1}\right] \cos 2\pi\theta + \left[\frac{x}{2}\right] \cos 4\pi\theta + \left[\frac{x}{3}\right] \cos 6\pi\theta + \left[\frac{x}{4}\right] \cos 8\pi\theta + \cdots$

$= -x \log(2\sin\pi\theta) + \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{x} \sum_{\lambda=1}^{\lambda=\infty} \left\{ \frac{I_1(4\pi\sqrt{\lambda\theta x})}{\sqrt{\lambda\theta}} + \frac{I_1(4\pi\sqrt{\lambda(1-\theta)x})}{\sqrt{\lambda(1-\theta)}} + \frac{I_1(4\pi\sqrt{\lambda(1+\theta)x})}{\sqrt{\lambda(1+\theta)}} + \frac{I_1(4\pi\sqrt{\lambda(2-\theta)x})}{\sqrt{\lambda(2-\theta)}} + \frac{I_1(4\pi\sqrt{\lambda(2+\theta)x})}{\sqrt{\lambda(2+\theta)}} + \cdots\cdots \right\},$

where $I_1(x) = H_1(x) - Y_1(x).$

[pencil, other hand:] Allied to divisor problem
Formulae new to me

methods.what: Expansion of the sum of [x/n] sin 2nπθ as an elementary main term plus a series of Bessel functions J_1 over λ and shifted arguments θ, 1−θ, 1+θ, 2−θ, 2+θ, …
Convention for the integer-part function at integer points: the value at a jump is the midpoint
methods.quote: where $[x]$ denotes the greatest integer in $x$ if $x$ is not an integer and $x - \frac{1}{2}$ if $x$ is an integer.

methods.what: Expansion of the sum of [x/n] cos 2nπθ as −x log(2 sin πθ) + 1/4 plus a series of the functions I_1 = H_1 − Y_1 (Struve minus Bessel of the second kind)
Definition of the auxiliary function as Struve function minus Bessel function of the second kind

items.english: For 0<θ<1, the sine sum of [x/n] equals the stated main term plus the J_1 Bessel series.
For 0<θ<1, the cosine sum of [x/n] equals −x log(2 sin πθ) + 1/4 plus the I_1 series.
